title: The least-fixed-point theorem requires an endofunction of one partial-function space.
details: Baldan academic-year2025/2026 notes Theorem17.9 p97, visually checked2026-11-10, declares Phi:F(N^k) to F(N^h) for unrelated k,h and then asserts Phi(f)=f and iteration Phi^n(empty). Those expressions are not well-typed in the declared spaces unless the input/output arities match. Add k=h, or state the theorem for unary partial-function endofunctions as the corpus does. Monotonicity/finite-evidence continuity and effective iteration then prove the standard least-fixed-point theorem. Adjacent examples have matching arity and are not counterexamples to the corrected result.
